name: Corona Australis
introduction: is the Southern Crown, one of Ptolemy’s original constellations, a delicate arc of stars south of Sagittarius.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The Corona Australis Molecular Cloud, about 430 light-years away, is a nearby star-forming region, home to the young Coronet Cluster.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Meridiana](hip:94114), Alpha Coronae Australis, is a white star 120 light-years away. [Beta Coronae Australis](hip:94160) is an orange giant, and [Gamma Coronae Australis](hip:93825) a binary of two yellow-white stars.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Corona Australis also contains the globular cluster NGC 6541.
